cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

mechanism: A recruits a former pupil as corroborator by teaching it how to present A preferred chore arrangement confidently.

comparison: Household rota support versus workplace support reduced from words to demeanor.
